metadata.title: go-ethereum Security Audit Checklist - Block Processing (Partial 4)
metadata.scope: Block Processing and State Transition Sub-graphs (non-boundary edges)

checklist.title: Transaction to Message Conversion Correctness

detection_procedure.description: Verify that TransactionToMessage correctly decodes all transaction types (Legacy, AccessList, DynamicFee, Blob, SetCode) into the Message struct with proper effective gas price calculation per EIP-1559.
steps: 1. Locate TransactionToMessage in core/state_transition.go
2. Verify sender recovery uses correct signer for the chain config and block number
3. Check effective gas price calculation: min(baseFee + maxPriorityFeePerGas, maxFeePerGas)
4. Verify all transaction fields are correctly mapped to Message fields
5. Check handling of nil values and edge cases (e.g., legacy transactions without access list)

checklist.notes: Incorrect sender recovery would allow unauthorized account access. Incorrect gas price affects block economics.

checklist.title: Transaction Context Setup for Logs

detection_procedure.description: Verify SetTxContext correctly associates transaction hash and index with the state database for proper log attribution.
steps: 1. Find SetTxContext in core/state/statedb.go
2. Verify transaction hash and index are stored correctly
3. Check that AddLog uses these values when creating log entries
4. Verify logs can be correctly filtered by transaction hash after execution

checklist.notes: Incorrect context leads to orphaned or misattributed logs, breaking event tracking.

checklist.title: Transaction Execution Atomicity

detection_procedure.description: Verify ApplyTransaction and state transition function execute transactions atomically with proper snapshot/revert handling.
steps: 1. Locate ApplyMessage in core/state_transition.go
2. Verify state snapshot is taken before execution
3. Check that failed transactions properly revert all state changes except gas consumption
4. Verify successful transactions commit all changes atomically
5. Check for proper handling of out-of-gas during execution

checklist.notes: Non-atomic execution can lead to partially applied state changes, causing consensus failures.

checklist.title: Execution Result Integrity

detection_procedure.description: Verify the execution result accurately reflects gas used, return data, and execution outcome.
steps: 1. Examine ExecutionResult struct in core/vm/evm.go or core/state_transition.go
2. Verify UsedGas is correctly calculated (initial gas - remaining gas)
3. Check ReturnData captures the correct bytes from execution
4. Verify Err field accurately reflects the execution outcome

checklist.notes: Incorrect execution result corrupts receipts and breaks light client verification.

checklist.title: Receipt Generation Correctness

detection_procedure.description: Verify receipts are correctly generated with status, cumulative gas, and logs from execution results.
steps: 1. Find receipt creation in core/state_processor.go
2. Verify Status reflects execution success/failure correctly
3. Check CumulativeGasUsed is correctly accumulated
4. Verify logs are correctly copied to the receipt
5. Check Bloom filter is correctly generated from logs

checklist.notes: Incorrect receipts cause receipt root mismatch and block rejection.

checklist.title: Transaction Iteration Completeness

detection_procedure.description: Verify all transactions in the block are processed before transitioning to system calls.
steps: 1. Find transaction iteration loop in core/state_processor.go Process function
2. Verify the loop correctly iterates over all block.Transactions()
3. Check that loop doesn't exit prematurely on non-fatal errors
4. Verify transaction count matches receipts generated

checklist.notes: Skipped transactions would cause state and receipt root mismatches.

checklist.title: Prague System Calls Execution

detection_procedure.description: Verify EIP-6110/7002/7251 system calls are executed correctly after user transactions with SYSTEM_ADDRESS as caller.
steps: 1. Locate ProcessRequests or similar in core/state_processor.go
2. Verify system calls use SystemAddress (0xfffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffe)
3. Check deposit, withdrawal, and consolidation request contracts are called in correct order
4. Verify results are collected and included in requests_hash

checklist.notes: System calls must execute in deterministic order with correct caller for consensus.

checklist.title: Block Finalization Correctness

detection_procedure.description: Verify consensus engine finalization applies correct rewards (pre-merge) or no rewards (post-merge).
steps: 1. Find Finalize in consensus/beacon/consensus.go and consensus/ethash/consensus.go
2. Verify post-merge beacon engine applies no block rewards
3. Check pre-merge ethash correctly calculates block and uncle rewards
4. Verify finalization is the last state modification before root computation

checklist.notes: Incorrect rewards would cause state root mismatch and economic exploitation.

checklist.title: Process Result Completeness

detection_procedure.description: Verify process result contains all receipts, requests, logs, and accurate gas accounting.
steps: 1. Find Process function return in core/state_processor.go
2. Verify receipts slice contains exactly len(block.Transactions()) receipts
3. Check requests are properly collected (Prague+)
4. Verify usedGas matches sum of individual transaction gas

checklist.notes: Incomplete results cause header validation failures.

checklist.title: Block Processing Initialization Order

detection_procedure.description: Verify block processing initialization extracts header data (number, timestamp, coinbase) before any execution.
steps: 1. Find Process function entry in core/state_processor.go
2. Verify header fields are accessed for context setup
3. Check vmConfig is properly initialized with block context
4. Verify no execution occurs before initialization completes

checklist.notes: Incorrect block context affects TIMESTAMP, NUMBER, COINBASE opcodes.

checklist.title: Fork Mutations Application Order

detection_procedure.description: Verify hard fork state mutations are applied after initialization but before beacon root processing.
steps: 1. Find ApplyDAOHardFork or similar fork handling in core/state_processor.go
2. Verify fork mutations happen before ProcessBeaconBlockRoot
3. Check fork checks use correct activation block/timestamp
4. Verify all fork-specific state mutations are applied

checklist.notes: Fork mutations must precede execution for correct state.

checklist.title: Beacon Root Processing Order (EIP-4788)

detection_procedure.description: Verify beacon root is stored before any user transaction can access it.
steps: 1. Find ProcessBeaconBlockRoot in core/state_processor.go
2. Verify it's called after fork mutations but before transaction loop
3. Check system call uses SystemAddress as caller
4. Verify timestamp -> root mapping is correctly stored

checklist.notes: Beacon root must be available for BEACON_ROOT opcode in user contracts.

checklist.title: Parent Hash Storage Order (EIP-2935)

detection_procedure.description: Verify parent hash is stored before user transactions for BLOCKHASH extended history.
steps: 1. Find ProcessParentBlockHash in core/state_processor.go
2. Verify it's called after beacon root but before transaction loop
3. Check system call correctly stores parent hash at ring buffer index
4. Verify HistoryStorageAddress is called with correct parameters

checklist.notes: Extended BLOCKHASH history must be available for Prague+ contracts.

checklist.title: Transaction Iteration Start Timing

detection_procedure.description: Verify transaction iteration only begins after all pre-transaction setup is complete.
steps: 1. Verify Process function order: init -> forks -> beacon -> parent -> transactions
2. Check that system call state changes are visible to first transaction
3. Verify no transaction execution occurs during setup phase

checklist.notes: First transaction must see all system call state changes.

checklist.title: Transaction Order Preservation

detection_procedure.description: Verify transactions are processed in exact block order (index 0, 1, 2, ...).
steps: 1. Find transaction loop in core/state_processor.go
2. Verify iteration uses sequential index, not arbitrary order
3. Check transaction index is correctly passed to SetTxContext
4. Verify no sorting or reordering occurs

executable_checks: grep -n 'for i, tx := range\|for i :=.*Transactions' core/state_processor.go
checklist.notes: Transaction order affects final state; must match block encoding exactly.

checklist.title: Message Context Derivation Correctness

detection_procedure.description: Verify sender is correctly derived from signature using secp256k1 recovery.
steps: 1. Find AsMessage or TransactionToMessage implementation
2. Verify Signer uses correct chain ID for replay protection
3. Check signature recovery uses proper V, R, S handling for different tx types
4. Verify EIP-1559 gas price calculation is correct

checklist.notes: Incorrect sender recovery enables transaction impersonation.

checklist.title: Execution Result Gas Accuracy

detection_procedure.description: Verify execution result contains accurate gas usage matching EVM metering.
steps: 1. Trace gas calculation through state_transition.go
2. Verify UsedGas = msg.Gas - st.gas (initial - remaining)
3. Check refund is correctly applied to effective gas used
4. Verify gas accounting matches EIP-3529 refund caps

checklist.notes: Incorrect gas accounting corrupts cumulative gas and receipts.

checklist.title: Receipt Data Capture Correctness

detection_procedure.description: Verify receipt accurately captures execution outcome including logs and status.
steps: 1. Find receipt creation in core/state_processor.go
2. Verify Status is set correctly (1 for success, 0 for failure)
3. Check logs are deep-copied from statedb
4. Verify contract address is set for successful creations

checklist.notes: Receipt must exactly match execution for light client proofs.

checklist.title: Transaction Loop Continuation

detection_procedure.description: Verify loop correctly advances to next transaction without skipping.
steps: 1. Verify for loop increment is standard (i++)
2. Check no break or continue statements can cause skipping
3. Verify failed transactions don't terminate loop prematurely
4. Check error handling allows continuation

checklist.notes: Premature loop exit causes transaction skipping and consensus failure.

checklist.title: Transaction Loop Termination

detection_procedure.description: Verify loop exits only when all transactions have been processed.
steps: 1. Verify loop condition correctly uses len(block.Transactions())
2. Check no early exit conditions except for block validation errors
3. Verify len(receipts) == len(block.Transactions()) at exit

checklist.notes: Must process all transactions before proceeding to system calls.
